summary.text: Dana Jones is a Republican state senator from North Carolina who represents District 31, covering Forsyth and Stokes counties, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, against Democrat Andy Bowline.
A business owner and former school board member, she took office in January 2025.

paragraphs.text: Jones earned a B.A. in political science from High Point University in 1993, according to Ballotpedia.

She is the owner of Caudill's Commercial Electric Company, Inc. in Kernersville, served four terms on the Kernersville Board of Aldermen and has served on the board of the Kernersville Medical Center.
Jones was a member of the Winston-Salem/Forsyth County Schools school board for District 2 from 2014 to 2023.
She won the District 31 Senate seat in 2024, succeeding Joyce Krawiec, and took office on January 1, 2025.

The General Assembly's website shows her committee assignments in Appropriations on Education/Higher Education, Education/Higher Education, Regulatory Reform, State and Local Government, and Transportation.
The Republican primary for her seat on March 3, 2026, was canceled.
